Bexley Terrace, Harehills, Leeds | 2 Bedroom Home | Available Now | £975 pcm | £1125 Deposit | 3D Virtual Tour Available

 If you're after a home with real space and a bit of character, this one's worth a look.

 From the outside, it's a classic Leeds red-brick terrace sitting in a row of similar period properties. There's on-street parking available and a neatly paved front garden enclosed by a picket fence — a lovely spot to catch some sun or keep bikes out of the way.

 Inside, the ground floor has a bright and airy living room with original coving, a ceiling rose and warm wood-effect flooring — a really pleasant space to come home to. The kitchen sits just off the living area, fitted with white units, a gas hob and oven, metro-tiled splashback and a fridge freezer included.

 Head upstairs and you'll find a well-finished bathroom with large stone-effect tiles, a P-shaped bath with shower screen and a new combi boiler, alongside a generous double bedroom with plush carpet and a feature accent wall.

 On the top floor there's a second bedroom lit by a Velux skylight, giving it a bright and airy feel with its own radiator — a great private retreat. The large landing area outside also offers useful additional space.

 And then there's the basement — two rooms, fully boarded with power and lighting already in place. Whether you need serious storage, a workshop, a home gym or a hobby space, it's a genuinely brilliant bonus that most houses in this area simply don't have.
